name: Chunked Voxel Evaluation (Top-Down Procedural Generation)
definition: Evaluates procedural voxel generation per chunk by passing high-level object parameters from CPU to GPU, deriving local coordinates per chunk to render objects spanning multiple chunks.
summary: Chunked Voxel Evaluation generates voxel data on-demand via GPU shaders using CPU-computed parameters, enabling large continuous procedural worlds without pre-computed storage or explicit meshing.
